text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a cross-post plan for the webinar + benchmark blog during launch week. LinkedIn long post, X thread, and 3 short variations. timeline: next Tue launch.

sam: Got it. Can we list assets needed and who owns them?

maria: Assets: hero image (1200x628), 2 variant carousel cards, 1 short webinar clip (30s), one pull-quote graphic, source deck PDF. Owners: devon design, jia copy for pull quotes, luis to sign off on technical claims.

devon: I can do hero + carousel. Need final headline and 1 alt headline by EOD Friday. PNG + SVG. Any animation requests for the 30s clip?

jia: For X thread, propose 6 tweets: hook, one benchmark stat, short explainer, product angle, CTA to signup, closing. I'll draft thread copy and 3 LinkedIn variants (short/medium/long).

luis: Call out on the benchmark stat — use "~2x throughput at 50% lower token cost" wording? We need to be precise. I'll confirm numbers by Thu. Don't publish claims until I sign off.

sam: Routing: when folks sign up from LinkedIn/X -> landing page with UTM. Can we push leads into HubSpot and tag source=social_launch2026? Also route MQLs to sales queue A.

maria: Yes — UTM pattern: `utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_content={channel}`. Sam, can you wire up Zapier/HubSpot mapping?

sam: On it. I'll create a Zap: form -> add contact -> set property Source = social_launch2026 -> assign to queue A. Will share mapping later.

jia: For engagement follow-ups: 24h pinned comment on X thread with webinar link + short TL;DR. Day 2: reply with clip. Day 5: retarget CTA for on-demand. Template for pinned reply: "Missed the live demo? Watch on demand: <link> — TL;DR: key stat + 2 bullets."

devon: Uploaded 3 comps to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/launch-hero (please comment). I'll export sizes when copy is final.

maria: Scheduling matrix (draft):
````
Tue 09:00 PT LinkedIn long post (company)
Tue 10:00 PT X thread (company) + boost pin
Tue 14:00 PT short clip (X, LinkedIn feed)
Wed 11:00 PT carousel variant (LinkedIn)
Thu 09:00 PT pull-quote + webinar reminder
````
Adjust times based on regions.

luis: Can we add a developer-focused tweet calling out integration steps and SDK link? I'll write the blurb.

sam: Also need CTA variants for paid vs organic. Suggest organic CTA = "Register — seats limited" and paid CTA = "Join live + get early access".

maria: Final checklist: copy drafts by Fri EOD, design assets by Mon, tracking + Zap by Mon, luis sign-off Thu. If all green we schedule posts Tue morning.

alex-bot: Reminder set: social-posts-check at 1768200000 (calendar invite sent to @maria @sam @devon @jia). :bell:

maria: Perfect — quick sync tomorrow 9am PT? 15m to finalize headlines. :spiral_calendar: :thumbsup:

sam: 9am works for me.

devon: i'll be there.

jia: see you.

luis: Added to calendar. Will have numbers ready. :eyes:
